what_happened: Re-verifying the dispatch's 2026-11-02 measurements found specs/CHANGE_LOG.md was caught up by a batched /todo run on 2026-11-04 (one day before this dispatch), reversing the staleness premise; also found the CHANGE_LOG reference count drifted from 3 to 5 files and that this repository's own ROADMAP.md carries no Maintenance section to fix. Re-verification changed the conclusion rather than just confirming it.

Found that scripts/dispatch-metrics.sh already joins git commits to dispatches via session_id (git log --grep), not via the task {N}: commit-message prefix, settling the design's hardest question (the commit-convention/renumbering tension) with existing evidence rather than a new mechanism. Also found five already-abandoned sibling proposals (carry_reason_on_dependency_edges and four others) corroborating the no-new-mechanism verdict.
